params.long:
Defines which mixer implementation to use.
Some are generic, while others are specifically fit to a certain vehicle with a fixed set of actuators.

params.name: CA_HELI_PITCH_C0
params.long:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 0 for a given thrust setpoint.

Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

params.name: CA_HELI_PITCH_C1
params.long:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 1 for a given thrust setpoint.

Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

params.name: CA_HELI_PITCH_C2
params.long:

params.name: CA_HELI_PITCH_C3

params.name: CA_HELI_PITCH_C4

params.name: CA_HELI_RPM_I
params.long: Same definition as the proportional gain but for integral.

params.name: CA_HELI_RPM_P
params.long:
Ratio between rpm error devided by 1000 to how much normalized output gets added to correct for it.

motor_command = throttle_curve + CA_HELI_RPM_P * (rpm_setpoint - rpm_measurement) / 1000

params.name: CA_HELI_RPM_SP
params.long: Requires rpm feedback for the controller.

params.name: CA_HELI_THR_C0
params.long: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 0.

params.name: CA_HELI_THR_C1
params.long: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 1.

params.name: CA_HELI_THR_C2
params.long: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 2.

params.name: CA_HELI_THR_C3
params.long: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 3.

params.name: CA_HELI_THR_C4
params.long: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 4.

params.name: CA_HELI_YAW_CCW
params.long:
Default configuration is for a clockwise turning main rotor and
positive thrust of the tail rotor is expected to rotate the vehicle clockwise.
Set this parameter to true if the tail rotor provides thrust in counter-clockwise direction
which is mostly the case when the main rotor turns counter-clockwise.

params.name: CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O
params.short: Offset for yaw compensation based on collective pitch
params.long:
This allows to specify which collective pitch command results in the least amount of rotor drag.
This is used to increase the accuracy of the yaw drag torque compensation based on collective pitch
by aligning the lowest rotor drag with zero compensation.
For symmetric profile blades this is the command that results in exactly 0° collective blade angle.
For lift profile blades this is typically a command resulting in slightly negative collective blade angle.

tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S * abs(collective_pitch - CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O)

params.name: CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S
params.short: Scale for yaw compensation based on collective pitch
params.long:
This allows to add a proportional factor of the collective pitch command to the yaw command.
A negative value is needed when positive thrust of the tail rotor rotates the vehicle opposite to the main rotor turn direction.

tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S * abs(collective_pitch - CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O)

params.name: CA_HELI_YAW_TH_S
params.short: Scale for yaw compensation based on throttle
params.long:
This allows to add a proportional factor of the throttle command to the yaw command.
A negative value is needed when positive thrust of the tail rotor rotates the vehicle opposite to the main rotor turn direction.

tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_TH_S * throttle

params.name: CA_MAX_SVO_THROW
params.short: Throw angle of swashplate servo at maximum commands for linearization
params.long:
Used to linearize mechanical output of swashplate servos to avoid axis coupling and binding with 4 servo redundancy.
This requires a symmetric setup where the servo horn is exactly centered with a 0 command.
Setting to zero disables feature.

params.name: CA_METHOD
params.long:
Selects the algorithm and desaturation method.
If set to Automatic, the selection is based on the airframe (CA_AIRFRAME).

This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

params.name: COM_MODE7_HASH
params.long:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

params.name: COM_MODE_ARM_CHK
params.short: Allow external mode registration while armed.
params.long: By default disabled for safety reasons

params.name: COM_MOT_TEST_EN
params.long:
If set, enables the actuator test interface via MAVLink (ACTUATOR_TEST), that
allows spinning the motors and moving the servos for testing purposes.

params.name: COM_OBC_LOSS_T
params.short: Time-out to wait when onboard computer connection is lost before warning about loss connection.

params.name: COM_OBL_RC_ACT
params.long:
The offboard loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_OF_LOSS_T in seconds.

params.name: COM_OF_LOSS_T
params.short: Time-out to wait when offboard connection is lost before triggering offboard lost action.
params.long: See COM_OBL_RC_ACT to configure action.

params.name: COM_PARACHUTE
params.short: Expect and require a healthy MAVLink parachute system

params.name: COM_POS_FS_EPH
params.short: Horizontal position error threshold for hovering systems
params.long:
This is the horizontal position error (EPH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe.
If the previous position error was below this threshold, there is an additional
factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).
Only used for multicopters and VTOLs in hover mode.
Independent from estimator positioning data timeout threshold (see EKF2_NOAID_TOUT).

Set to -1 to disable.

params.name: COM_POS_LOW_ACT
params.long:
Action the system takes when the estimated position has an accuracy below the specified threshold.
See COM_POS_LOW_EPH to set the failsafe threshold.
The failsafe action is only executed if the vehicle is in auto mission or auto loiter mode,
otherwise it is only a warning.

params.name: COM_POS_LOW_EPH
params.long:
This triggers the action specified in COM_POS_LOW_ACT if the estimated position accuracy is below this threshold.
Local position has to be still declared valid, which requires some kind of velocity aiding or large dead-reckoning time (EKF2_NOAID_TOUT),
and a high failsafe threshold (COM_POS_FS_EPH).

Set to -1 to disable.

params.name: COM_POWER_COUNT
params.short: Required number of redundant power modules
params.long:
This configures a check to verify the expected number of 5V rail power supplies are present. By default only one is expected.
Note: CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK disables all power checks including this one.

params.name: COM_PREARM_MODE
params.long:
Condition to enter the prearmed state, an intermediate state between disarmed and armed
in which non-throttling actuators are active.

params.name: COM_RAM_MAX
params.short: Maximum allowed RAM usage to pass checks
params.long:
The check fails if the RAM usage is above this threshold.

A negative value disables the check.

params.name: COM_RCL_EXCEPT
params.long:
Specify modes where manual control loss is ignored and no failsafe is triggered.
External modes requiring stick input will still failsafe.

params.name: COM_RC_ARM_HYST
params.short: Manual control input arm/disarm command duration
params.long: The default value of 1000 requires the stick to be held in the arm or disarm position for 1 second.

params.name: COM_RC_IN_MODE
params.long:
Selects stick input selection behavior:
either a traditional remote control receiver (RC) or a MAVLink joystick (MANUAL_CONTROL message)

Priority sources are immediately switched to whenever they get valid.

0 RC only. Requires valid RC calibration.
1 MAVLink only. RC and related checks are disabled.
2 Switches only if current source becomes invalid.
3 Locks to the first valid source until reboot.
4 Ignores all sources.
5 RC priority, then MAVLink (lower instance before higher)
6 MAVLink priority (lower instance before higher), then RC
7 RC priority, then MAVLink (higher instance before lower)
8 MAVLink priority (higher instance before lower), then RC

params.name: COM_RC_LOSS_T
params.long:
The time in seconds without a new setpoint from RC or Joystick, after which the connection is considered lost.
This must be kept short as the vehicle will use the last supplied setpoint until the timeout triggers.
Ensure the value is not set lower than the update interval of the RC or Joystick.

params.name: COM_RC_OVERRIDE
params.long:
When enabled, moving the sticks more than COM_RC_STICK_OV
immediately gives control back to the pilot by switching to Position mode and
if position is unavailable Altitude mode.
Note: Only has an effect on multicopters, and VTOLs in multicopter mode.

params.name: COM_RC_STICK_OV
params.long:
If COM_RC_OVERRIDE is enabled and the joystick input is moved more than this threshold
the autopilot the pilot takes over control.

params.name: COM_SPOOLUP_TIME
params.short: Enforced delay between arming and further navigation
params.long:
The minimal time from arming the motors until moving the vehicle is possible is COM_SPOOLUP_TIME seconds.
Goal:
- Motors and propellers spool up to idle speed before getting commanded to spin faster
- Timeout for ESCs and smart batteries to successfulyy do failure checks
e.g. for stuck rotors before the vehicle is off the ground

params.name: COM_TAKEOFF_ACT
params.short: Action after TAKEOFF has been accepted.
params.long: The mode transition after TAKEOFF has completed successfully.

params.name: COM_THROW_EN
params.long: Allows to start the vehicle by throwing it into the air.

params.name: COM_THROW_SPEED
params.short: Minimum speed for the throw start
params.long:
When the throw launch is enabled, the drone will only allow motors to spin after this speed
is exceeded before detecting the freefall. This is a safety feature to ensure the drone does
not turn on after accidental drop or a rapid movement before the throw.

Set to 0 to disable.

params.name: COM_VEL_FS_EVH
params.long:
This is the horizontal velocity error (EVH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe.
The default is appropriate for a multicopter. Can be increased for a fixed-wing.
If the previous velocity error was below this threshold, there is an additional
factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).

params.name: COM_WIND_MAX
params.long:
Wind speed threshold above which an automatic failsafe action is triggered.
Failsafe action can be specified with COM_WIND_MAX_ACT.

params.name: COM_WIND_MAX_ACT
params.long:
Action the system takes when a wind speed above the specified threshold is detected.
See COM_WIND_MAX to set the failsafe threshold.
If enabled, it is not possible to resume the mission or switch to any auto mode other than
RTL or Land if this threshold is exceeded. Taking over in any manual
mode is still possible.

params.name: COM_WIND_WARN
params.long:
A warning is triggered if the currently estimated wind speed is above this value.
Warning is sent periodically (every 1 minute).

Set to -1 to disable.

params.name: EKF2_ANGERR_INIT
params.short: 1-sigma tilt angle uncertainty after gravity vector alignment

params.name: EKF2_DELAY_MAX
params.short: Maximum delay of all the aiding sensors
params.long: Defines the delay between the current time and the delayed-time horizon. This value should be at least as large as the largest EKF2_XXX_DELAY parameter.

params.name: EKF2_GYR_NOISE
params.short: Rate gyro noise for covariance prediction

params.name: EKF2_HDG_GATE
params.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

params.name: EKF2_HEAD_NOISE
params.short: Measurement noise for magnetic heading fusion

params.name: EKF2_HGT_REF
params.short: Determines the reference source of height data used by the EKF
params.long: When multiple height sources are enabled at the same time, the height estimate will always converge towards the reference height source selected by this parameter. The range sensor and vision options should only be used when for operation over a flat surface as the local NED origin will move up and down with ground level. If GPS is set as reference but altitude fusion is disabled in EKF2_GPS_CTRL, the GPS altitude is still used to initiaize the bias of the other height sensors.

params.name: EKF2_IMU_POS_X
params.short: X position of IMU in body frame
params.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

params.name: EKF2_IMU_POS_Y
params.short: Y position of IMU in body frame
params.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

params.name: EKF2_IMU_POS_Z
params.short: Z position of IMU in body frame
params.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

params.name: EKF2_NOAID_NOISE
params.short: Measurement noise for non-aiding position hold

params.name: EKF2_NOAID_TOUT
params.long: Maximum lapsed time from last fusion of measurements that constrain velocity drift before the EKF will report the horizontal nav solution as invalid

params.name: EKF2_PREDICT_US
params.long: EKF prediction period in microseconds. This should ideally be an integer multiple of the IMU time delta. Actual filter update will be an integer multiple of IMU update.

params.name: EKF2_TAU_POS
params.long: Controls how tightly the output track the EKF states

params.name: EKF2_TAU_VEL
params.short: Time constant of the velocity output prediction and smoothing filter

params.name: FD_ACT_EN
params.long:
If enabled, failure detector will verify that for motors, a minimum amount of ESC current per throttle
level is being consumed.
Otherwise this indicates an motor failure.

params.name: FD_ACT_MOT_C2T
params.long: Motor failure triggers only below this current value

params.name: FD_ACT_MOT_THR
params.long: Motor failure triggers only above this throttle value.

params.name: FD_ACT_MOT_TOUT
params.long:
Motor failure triggers only if the throttle threshold and the
current to throttle threshold are violated for this time.

params.name: FD_ESCS_EN
params.short: Enable checks on ESCs that report their arming state.
params.long:
If enabled, failure detector will verify that all the ESCs have successfully armed when the vehicle has transitioned to the armed state.
Timeout for receiving an acknowledgement from the ESCs is 0.3s, if no feedback is received the failure detector will auto disarm the vehicle.

params.name: FD_EXT_ATS_EN
params.short: Enable PWM input on for engaging failsafe from an external automatic trigger system (ATS).
params.long:
Enabled on either AUX5 or MAIN5 depending on board.
External ATS is required by ASTM F3322-18.

params.name: FD_EXT_ATS_TRIG
params.short: The PWM threshold from external automatic trigger system for engaging failsafe.
params.long: External ATS is required by ASTM F3322-18.

params.name: FD_FAIL_P
params.long:
Maximum pitch angle before FailureDetector triggers the attitude_failure flag.
The flag triggers flight termination (if @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM = 0),
which sets outputs to their failsafe values.
On takeoff the flag triggers lockdown (irrespective of @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM),
which disarms motors but does not set outputs to failsafe values.

Setting this parameter to 0 disables the check

params.name: FD_FAIL_P_TTRI
params.long: Seconds (decimal) that pitch has to exceed FD_FAIL_P before being considered as a failure.

params.name: FD_FAIL_R
params.long:
Maximum roll angle before FailureDetector triggers the attitude_failure flag.
The flag triggers flight termination (if @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM = 0),
which sets outputs to their failsafe values.
On takeoff the flag triggers lockdown (irrespective of @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM),
which disarms motors but does not set outputs to failsafe values.

Setting this parameter to 0 disables the check

params.name: FD_FAIL_R_TTRI
params.long: Seconds (decimal) that roll has to exceed FD_FAIL_R before being considered as a failure.

params.name: FD_IMB_PROP_THR
params.long:
Value at which the imbalanced propeller metric (based on horizontal and
vertical acceleration variance) triggers a failure

Setting this value to 0 disables the feature.

params.name: GPS_1_GNSS
params.short: GNSS Systems for Primary GPS (integer bitmask)
params.long:
This integer bitmask controls the set of GNSS systems used by the receiver. Check your
receiver's documentation on how many systems are supported to be used in parallel.

Currently this functionality is just implemented for u-blox receivers.

When no bits are set, the receiver's default configuration should be used.

Set bits true to enable:
0 : Use GPS (with QZSS)
1 : Use SBAS (multiple GPS augmentation systems)
2 : Use Galileo
3 : Use BeiDou
4 : Use GLONASS
5 : Use NAVIC

params.name: GPS_1_PROTOCOL
params.long:
Select the GPS protocol over serial.

Auto-detection will probe all protocols, and thus is a bit slower.

params.name: GPS_2_GNSS
params.short: GNSS Systems for Secondary GPS (integer bitmask)
params.long:
This integer bitmask controls the set of GNSS systems used by the receiver. Check your
receiver's documentation on how many systems are supported to be used in parallel.

Currently this functionality is just implemented for u-blox receivers.

When no bits are set, the receiver's default configuration should be used.

Set bits true to enable:
0 : Use GPS (with QZSS)
1 : Use SBAS (multiple GPS augmentation systems)
2 : Use Galileo
3 : Use BeiDou
4 : Use GLONASS
5 : Use NAVIC

params.name: GPS_2_PROTOCOL
params.long:
Select the GPS protocol over serial.

Auto-detection will probe all protocols, and thus is a bit slower.

params.name: GPS_CFG_WIPE
params.short: Wipes the flash config of UBX modules.
params.long:
Some UBX modules have a FLASH that allows to store persistent configuration that will be loaded on start.
PX4 does override all configuration parameters it needs in RAM, which takes precedence over the values in FLASH.
However, configuration parameters that are not overriden by PX4 can still cause unexpected problems during flight.
To avoid these kind of problems a clean config can be reached by wiping the FLASH on boot.

Note: Currently only supported on UBX.

params.name: GPS_DUMP_COMM
params.long:
If this is set to 1, all GPS communication data will be published via uORB,
and written to the log file as gps_dump message.

If this is set to 2, the main GPS is configured to output RTCM data,
which is then logged as gps_dump and can be used for PPK.

params.name: GPS_SAT_INFO
params.long:
Enable publication of satellite info (ORB_ID(satellite_info)) if possible.
Not available on MTK.

params.name: GPS_UBX_BAUD2
params.long:
Select a baudrate for the F9P's UART2 port.
In GPS_UBX_MODE 1, 2, and 3, the F9P's UART2 port is configured to send/receive RTCM corrections.
Set this to 57600 if you want to attach a telemetry radio on UART2.

params.name: GPS_UBX_DYNMODEL
params.long:
u-blox receivers support different dynamic platform models to adjust the navigation engine to
the expected application environment.

params.name: GPS_UBX_MODE
params.long:
Select the u-blox configuration setup. Most setups will use the default, including RTK and
dual GPS without heading.

If rover has RTCM corrections from a static base (or other static correction source) coming in on UART2, then select Mode 5.
The Heading mode requires 2 F9P devices to be attached. The main GPS will act as rover and output
heading information, whereas the secondary will act as moving base.
Modes 1 and 2 require each F9P UART1 to be connected to the Autopilot. In addition, UART2 on the
F9P units are connected to each other.
Modes 3 and 4 only require UART1 on each F9P connected to the Autopilot or Can Node. UART RX DMA is required.
RTK is still possible with this setup.
Mode 6 is intended for use with a ground control station (not necessarily an RTK correction base).

values.1: Heading (Rover With Moving Base UART1 Connected To Autopilot, UART2 Connected To Moving Base)
values.2: Moving Base (UART1 Connected To Autopilot, UART2 Connected To Rover)
values.3: Heading (Rover With Moving Base UART1 Connected to Autopilot Or Can Node At 921600)
values.4: Moving Base (Moving Base UART1 Connected to Autopilot Or Can Node At 921600)
values.5: Rover with Static Base on UART2 (similar to Default, except coming in on UART2)

params.name: GPS_YAW_OFFSET
params.short: Heading/Yaw offset for dual antenna GPS
params.long:
Heading offset angle for dual antenna GPS setups that support heading estimation.

Set this to 0 if the antennas are parallel to the forward-facing direction
of the vehicle and the rover (or Unicore primary) antenna is in front.

The offset angle increases clockwise.

Set this to 90 if the rover (or Unicore primary, or Septentrio Mosaic Aux)
antenna is placed on the right side of the vehicle and the moving base
antenna is on the left side.

(Note: the Unicore primary antenna is the one connected on the right as seen
from the top).

params.name: IMU_ACCEL_CUTOFF
params.short: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for accel
params.long:
The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter on the primary accelerometer.
This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators. 0 disables the filter.

params.name: IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF
params.short: Cutoff frequency for angular acceleration (D-Term filter)
params.long:
The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter used on
the time derivative of the measured angular velocity, also known as
the D-term filter in the rate controller. The D-term uses the derivative of
the rate and thus is the most susceptible to noise. Therefore, using
a D-term filter allows to increase IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF, which
leads to reduced control latency and permits to increase the P gains.

A value of 0 disables the filter.

params.name: IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF
params.short: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for gyro
params.long:
The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter on the primary gyro.
This only affects the angular velocity sent to the controllers, not the estimators.
It applies also to the angular acceleration (D-Term filter), see IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF.

A value of 0 disables the filter.

params.name: IMU_GYRO_DNF_BW
params.short: IMU gyro ESC notch filter bandwidth
params.long: Bandwidth per notch filter when using dynamic notch filtering with ESC RPM.

params.name: IMU_GYRO_DNF_EN
params.long:
Enable bank of dynamically updating notch filters.
Requires ESC RPM feedback or onboard FFT (IMU_GYRO_FFT_EN).

params.name: IMU_GYRO_DNF_HMC
params.short: IMU gyro dynamic notch filter harmonics
params.long: ESC RPM number of harmonics (multiples of RPM) for ESC RPM dynamic notch filtering.

params.name: IMU_GYRO_DNF_MIN
params.short: IMU gyro dynamic notch filter minimum frequency
params.long: Minimum notch filter frequency in Hz.

params.name: IMU_GYRO_NF0_BW
params.long:
The frequency width of the stop band for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF0_FRQ" to activate the filter and to set the notch frequency.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.

params.name: IMU_GYRO_NF0_FRQ
params.long:
The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
This filter can be enabled to avoid feedback amplification of structural resonances at a specific frequency.
This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF0_BW" to set the bandwidth of the filter.

A value of 0 disables the filter.

params.name: IMU_GYRO_NF1_BW
params.long:
The frequency width of the stop band for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF1_FRQ" to activate the filter and to set the notch frequency.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.

params.name: IMU_GYRO_NF1_FRQ
params.long:
The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
This filter can be enabled to avoid feedback amplification of structural resonances at a specific frequency.
This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF1_BW" to set the bandwidth of the filter.

A value of 0 disables the filter.

params.name: IMU_GYRO_RATEMAX
params.short: Gyro control data maximum publication rate (inner loop rate)
params.long:
The maximum rate the gyro control data (vehicle_angular_velocity) will be
allowed to publish at. This is the loop rate for the rate controller and outputs.

Note: sensor data is always read and filtered at the full raw rate (eg commonly 8 kHz) regardless of this setting.

params.name: IMU_INTEG_RATE
params.long:
The rate at which raw IMU data is integrated to produce delta angles and delta velocities.
Recommended to set this to a multiple of the estimator update period (currently 10 ms for ekf2).

params.name: LNDFW_AIRSPD_MAX
params.long: Maximum airspeed allowed in the landed state

params.name: LNDFW_ROT_MAX
params.short: Fixed-wing land detector: max rotational speed
params.long:
Maximum allowed norm of the angular velocity in the landed state.
Only used if neither airspeed nor groundspeed can be used for landing detection.

params.name: LNDFW_TRIG_TIME
params.long: Time the land conditions (speeds and acceleration) have to be satisfied to detect a landing.

params.name: LNDFW_VEL_XY_MAX
params.short: Fixed-wing land detector: Max horizontal velocity threshold
params.long:
Maximum horizontal velocity allowed in the landed state.
A factor of 0.7 is applied in case of airspeed-less flying
(either because no sensor is present or sensor data got invalid in flight).

params.name: LNDFW_VEL_Z_MAX
params.short: Fixed-wing land detector: Max vertiacal velocity threshold
params.long: Maximum vertical velocity allowed in the landed state.

params.name: LNDFW_XYACC_MAX
params.short: Fixed-wing land detector: Max horizontal acceleration
params.long: Maximum horizontal (x,y body axes) acceleration allowed in the landed state

params.name: LNDMC_ALT_GND
params.long:
The height above ground below which ground effect creates barometric altitude errors.
A negative value indicates no ground effect.

params.name: LNDMC_ROT_MAX
params.long: Maximum allowed norm of the angular velocity (roll, pitch) in the landed state.

params.name: LNDMC_TRIG_TIME
params.long:
Total time it takes to go through all three land detection stages:
ground contact, maybe landed, landed
when all necessary conditions are constantly met.

params.name: LNDMC_XY_VEL_MAX
params.long: Maximum horizontal velocity allowed in the landed state

params.name: LNDMC_Z_VEL_MAX
params.long:
Vertical velocity threshold to detect landing.
Has to be set lower than the expected minimal speed for landing,
which is either MPC_LAND_SPEED or MPC_LAND_CRWL.
This is enforced by an automatic check.

params.name: LND_FLIGHT_T_HI
params.long:
Total flight time of this autopilot. Higher 32 bits of the value.
Flight time in microseconds = (LND_FLIGHT_T_HI << 32) | LND_FLIGHT_T_LO.

params.name: LND_FLIGHT_T_LO
params.long:
Total flight time of this autopilot. Lower 32 bits of the value.
Flight time in microseconds = (LND_FLIGHT_T_HI << 32) | LND_FLIGHT_T_LO.

params.name: MAV_0_BROADCAST
params.short: Broadcast heartbeats on local network for MAVLink instance 0
params.long:
This allows a ground control station to automatically find the drone
on the local network.

params.name: MAV_0_FLOW_CTRL
params.short: Enable serial flow control for instance 0
params.long:
This is used to force flow control on or off for the the mavlink
instance. By default it is auto detected. Use when auto detection fails.

params.name: MAV_0_FORWARD
params.short: Enable MAVLink Message forwarding for instance 0
params.long:
If enabled, forward incoming MAVLink messages to other MAVLink ports if the
message is either broadcast or the target is not the autopilot.

This allows for example a GCS to talk to a camera that is connected to the
autopilot via MAVLink (on a different link than the GCS).

params.name: MAV_0_HL_FREQ
params.short: Configures the frequency of HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 0
params.long:
Positive real value that configures the transmission frequency of the
HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 0, configured in iridium mode.
This parameter has no effect if the instance mode is different from iridium.

params.name: MAV_0_MODE
params.long:
The MAVLink Mode defines the set of streamed messages (for example the
vehicle's attitude) and their sending rates.

params.name: MAV_0_RADIO_CTL
params.short: Enable software throttling of mavlink on instance 0
params.long:
If enabled, MAVLink messages will be throttled according to
`txbuf` field reported by radio_status.

Requires a radio to send the mavlink message RADIO_STATUS.

params.name: MAV_0_RATE
params.short: Maximum MAVLink sending rate for instance 0
params.long:
Configure the maximum sending rate for the MAVLink streams in Bytes/sec.
If the configured streams exceed the maximum rate, the sending rate of
each stream is automatically decreased.

If this is set to 0 a value of half of the theoretical maximum bandwidth is used.
This corresponds to baudrate/20 Bytes/s (baudrate/10 = maximum data rate on
8N1-configured links).

params.name: MAV_0_REMOTE_PRT
params.long:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 0,
selected remote port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 0.

params.name: MAV_0_UDP_PRT
params.long:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 0,
selected udp port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 0.

params.name: MAV_1_BROADCAST
params.short: Broadcast heartbeats on local network for MAVLink instance 1
params.long:
This allows a ground control station to automatically find the drone
on the local network.

params.name: MAV_1_FLOW_CTRL
params.short: Enable serial flow control for instance 1
params.long:
This is used to force flow control on or off for the the mavlink
instance. By default it is auto detected. Use when auto detection fails.

params.name: MAV_1_FORWARD
params.short: Enable MAVLink Message forwarding for instance 1
params.long:
If enabled, forward incoming MAVLink messages to other MAVLink ports if the
message is either broadcast or the target is not the autopilot.

This allows for example a GCS to talk to a camera that is connected to the
autopilot via MAVLink (on a different link than the GCS).

params.name: MAV_1_HL_FREQ
params.short: Configures the frequency of HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 1
params.long:
Positive real value that configures the transmission frequency of the
HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 1, configured in iridium mode.
This parameter has no effect if the instance mode is different from iridium.

params.name: MAV_1_MODE
params.long:
The MAVLink Mode defines the set of streamed messages (for example the
vehicle's attitude) and their sending rates.

params.name: MAV_1_RADIO_CTL
params.short: Enable software throttling of mavlink on instance 1
params.long:
If enabled, MAVLink messages will be throttled according to
`txbuf` field reported by radio_status.

Requires a radio to send the mavlink message RADIO_STATUS.

params.name: MAV_1_RATE
params.short: Maximum MAVLink sending rate for instance 1
params.long:
Configure the maximum sending rate for the MAVLink streams in Bytes/sec.
If the configured streams exceed the maximum rate, the sending rate of
each stream is automatically decreased.

If this is set to 0 a value of half of the theoretical maximum bandwidth is used.
This corresponds to baudrate/20 Bytes/s (baudrate/10 = maximum data rate on
8N1-configured links).

params.name: MAV_1_REMOTE_PRT
params.long:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 1,
selected remote port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 1.

params.name: MAV_1_UDP_PRT
params.long:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 1,
selected udp port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 1.

params.name: MAV_2_BROADCAST
params.short: Broadcast heartbeats on local network for MAVLink instance 2
params.long:
This allows a ground control station to automatically find the drone
on the local network.

params.name: MAV_2_FLOW_CTRL
params.short: Enable serial flow control for instance 2
params.long:
This is used to force flow control on or off for the the mavlink
instance. By default it is auto detected. Use when auto detection fails.

params.name: MAV_2_FORWARD
params.short: Enable MAVLink Message forwarding for instance 2
params.long:
If enabled, forward incoming MAVLink messages to other MAVLink ports if the
message is either broadcast or the target is not the autopilot.

This allows for example a GCS to talk to a camera that is connected to the
autopilot via MAVLink (on a different link than the GCS).

params.name: MAV_2_HL_FREQ
params.short: Configures the frequency of HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 2
params.long:
Positive real value that configures the transmission frequency of the
HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 2, configured in iridium mode.
This parameter has no effect if the instance mode is different from iridium.

params.name: MAV_2_MODE
params.long:
The MAVLink Mode defines the set of streamed messages (for example the
vehicle's attitude) and their sending rates.

params.name: MAV_2_RADIO_CTL
params.short: Enable software throttling of mavlink on instance 2
params.long:
If enabled, MAVLink messages will be throttled according to
`txbuf` field reported by radio_status.

Requires a radio to send the mavlink message RADIO_STATUS.

params.name: MAV_2_RATE
params.short: Maximum MAVLink sending rate for instance 2
params.long:
Configure the maximum sending rate for the MAVLink streams in Bytes/sec.
If the configured streams exceed the maximum rate, the sending rate of
each stream is automatically decreased.

If this is set to 0 a value of half of the theoretical maximum bandwidth is used.
This corresponds to baudrate/20 Bytes/s (baudrate/10 = maximum data rate on
8N1-configured links).

params.name: MAV_2_REMOTE_PRT
params.long:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 2,
selected remote port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 2.

params.name: MAV_2_UDP_PRT
params.long:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 2,
selected udp port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 2.

params.name: MAV_FWDEXTSP
params.long:
If set to 1 incoming external setpoint messages will be directly forwarded
to the controllers if in offboard control mode

params.name: MAV_HASH_CHK_EN
params.long:
Disabling the parameter hash check functionality will make the mavlink instance
stream parameters continuously.

params.name: MAV_HB_FORW_EN
params.long:
The mavlink heartbeat message will not be forwarded if this parameter is set to 'disabled'.
The main reason for disabling heartbeats to be forwarded is because they confuse dronekit.

values.1: Version 1 with auto-upgrade to v2 if detected

params.name: MAV_RADIO_TOUT
params.short: Timeout in seconds for the RADIO_STATUS reports coming in
params.long:
If the connected radio stops reporting RADIO_STATUS for a certain time,
a warning is triggered and, if MAV_X_RADIO_CTL is enabled, the software-flow
control is reset.

params.name: MAV_SIK_RADIO_ID
params.long:
When non-zero the MAVLink app will attempt to configure the
SiK radio to this ID and re-set the parameter to 0. If the value
is negative it will reset the complete radio config to
factory defaults. Only applies if this mavlink instance is going through a SiK radio

params.name: MAV_S_FORWARD
params.long: TELEM2 on Skynode only.

params.name: MAV_S_MODE
params.short: MAVLink Mode for SOM to FMU communication channel
params.long:
The MAVLink Mode defines the set of streamed messages (for example the
vehicle's attitude) and their sending rates.

values.22: VTOL Standard (separate fixed rotors for hover and cruise flight)

params.name: MAV_USEHILGPS
params.short: Use/Accept HIL GPS message even if not in HIL mode
params.long: If set to 1 incoming HIL GPS messages are parsed.

params.name: MC_ACRO_EXPO
params.short: Acro mode roll, pitch expo factor
params.long:
Exponential factor for tuning the input curve shape.

0 Purely linear input curve
1 Purely cubic input curve

params.name: MC_ACRO_EXPO_Y
params.long:
Exponential factor for tuning the input curve shape.

0 Purely linear input curve
1 Purely cubic input curve

params.name: MC_ACRO_P_MAX
params.long: Full stick deflection leads to this rate.

params.name: MC_ACRO_R_MAX
params.long: Full stick deflection leads to this rate.

params.name: MC_ACRO_SUPEXPO
params.short: Acro mode roll, pitch super expo factor
params.long:
"Superexponential" factor for refining the input curve shape tuned using MC_ACRO_EXPO.

0 Pure Expo function
0.7 reasonable shape enhancement for intuitive stick feel
0.95 very strong bent input curve only near maxima have effect

params.name: MC_ACRO_SUPEXPOY
params.short: Acro mode yaw super expo factor
params.long:
"Superexponential" factor for refining the input curve shape tuned using MC_ACRO_EXPO_Y.

0 Pure Expo function
0.7 reasonable shape enhancement for intuitive stick feel
0.95 very strong bent input curve only near maxima have effect

params.name: MC_ACRO_Y_MAX
params.long: Full stick deflection leads to this rate.

params.name: MC_AIRMODE
params.long:
The air-mode enables the mixer to increase the total thrust of the multirotor
in order to keep attitude and rate control even at low and high throttle.

This function should be disabled during tuning as it will help the controller
to diverge if the closed-loop is unstable (i.e. the vehicle is not tuned yet).

Enabling air-mode for yaw requires the use of an arming switch.

params.name: MC_BAT_SCALE_EN
params.long:
This compensates for voltage drop of the battery over time by attempting to
normalize performance across the operating range of the battery. The copter
should constantly behave as if it was fully charged with reduced max acceleration
at lower battery percentages. i.e. if hover is at 0.5 throttle at 100% battery,
it will still be 0.5 at 60% battery.

params.name: MC_MAN_TILT_TAU
params.short: Manual tilt input filter time constant
params.long: Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter

params.name: MC_PITCHRATE_D
params.long: Pitch rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

params.name: MC_PITCHRATE_FF
params.long: Improves tracking performance.

params.name: MC_PITCHRATE_I
params.long: Pitch rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

params.name: MC_PITCHRATE_K
params.long:
Global gain of the controller.

This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller:
output = MC_PITCHRATE_K * (MC_PITCHRATE_P * error
+ MC_PITCHRATE_I * error_integral
+ MC_PITCHRATE_D * error_derivative)
Set MC_PITCHRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form.
Set MC_PITCHRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

params.name: MC_PITCHRATE_MAX
params.long:
Limit for pitch rate in manual and auto modes (except acro).
Has effect for large rotations in autonomous mode, to avoid large control
output and mixer saturation.

This is not only limited by the vehicle's properties, but also by the maximum
measurement rate of the gyro.

params.name: MC_PITCHRATE_P
params.long: Pitch rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

params.name: MC_PITCH_P
params.long: Pitch proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

params.name: MC_PR_INT_LIM
params.long: Pitch rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large pitch moment trim changes.

params.name: MC_ROLLRATE_D
params.long: Roll rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

params.name: MC_ROLLRATE_FF
params.long: Improves tracking performance.

params.name: MC_ROLLRATE_I
params.long: Roll rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

params.name: MC_ROLLRATE_K
params.long:
Global gain of the controller.

This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller:
output = MC_ROLLRATE_K * (MC_ROLLRATE_P * error
+ MC_ROLLRATE_I * error_integral
+ MC_ROLLRATE_D * error_derivative)
Set MC_ROLLRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form.
Set MC_ROLLRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

params.name: MC_ROLLRATE_MAX
params.long:
Limit for roll rate in manual and auto modes (except acro).
Has effect for large rotations in autonomous mode, to avoid large control
output and mixer saturation.

This is not only limited by the vehicle's properties, but also by the maximum
measurement rate of the gyro.

params.name: MC_ROLLRATE_P
params.long: Roll rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

params.name: MC_ROLL_P
params.long: Roll proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

params.name: MC_RR_INT_LIM
params.long: Roll rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large roll moment trim changes.

params.name: MC_YAWRATE_D
params.long: Yaw rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

params.name: MC_YAWRATE_FF
params.long: Improves tracking performance.

params.name: MC_YAWRATE_I
params.long: Yaw rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

params.name: MC_YAWRATE_K
params.long:
Global gain of the controller.

This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller:
output = MC_YAWRATE_K * (MC_YAWRATE_P * error
+ MC_YAWRATE_I * error_integral
+ MC_YAWRATE_D * error_derivative)
Set MC_YAWRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form.
Set MC_YAWRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

params.name: MC_YAWRATE_P
params.long: Yaw rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

params.name: MC_YAW_P
params.long: Yaw proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

params.name: MC_YAW_TQ_CUTOFF
params.short: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for yaw torque setpoint
params.long:
Reduces vibrations by lowering high frequency torque caused by rotor acceleration.
0 disables the filter

params.name: MC_YAW_WEIGHT
params.long:
A fraction [0,1] deprioritizing yaw compared to roll and pitch in non-linear attitude control.
Deprioritizing yaw is necessary because multicopters have much less control authority
in yaw compared to the other axes and it makes sense because yaw is not critical for
stable hovering or 3D navigation.

For yaw control tuning use MC_YAW_P. This ratio has no impact on the yaw gain.

params.name: MC_YR_INT_LIM
params.long: Yaw rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large yaw moment trim changes.

params.name: MPC_ACC_DECOUPLE
params.long:
Set to decouple tilt from vertical acceleration.
This provides smoother flight but slightly worse tracking in position and auto modes.
Unset if accurate position tracking during dynamic maneuvers is more important than a smooth flight.

params.name: MPC_ACC_DOWN_MAX
params.short: Maximum downwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes

params.name: MPC_ACC_HOR
params.short: Acceleration for autonomous and for manual modes
params.long: When piloting manually, this parameter is only used in MPC_POS_MODE Acceleration based.

params.name: MPC_ACC_HOR_MAX
params.long:
MPC_POS_MODE
1 just deceleration
4 not used, use MPC_ACC_HOR instead

params.name: MPC_ACC_UP_MAX
params.short: Maximum upwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes

params.name: MPC_ALT_MODE
params.long:
Control height
0: relative earth frame origin which may drift due to sensors
1: relative to ground (requires distance sensor) which changes with terrain variation.
It will revert to relative earth frame if the distance to ground estimate becomes invalid.
2: relative to ground (requires distance sensor) when stationary
and relative to earth frame when moving horizontally.
The speed threshold is MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY

params.name: MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY
params.short: Maximum horizontal velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check)
params.long: Only used with MPC_POS_MODE Direct velocity or MPC_ALT_MODE 2

params.name: MPC_HOLD_MAX_Z
params.short: Maximum vertical velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check)
params.long: Only used with MPC_ALT_MODE 1

params.name: MPC_JERK_AUTO
params.long:
Limit the maximum jerk of the vehicle (how fast the acceleration can change).
A lower value leads to smoother vehicle motions but also limited agility.

params.name: MPC_JERK_MAX
params.short: Maximum horizontal and vertical jerk in Position/Altitude mode
params.long:
Limit the maximum jerk (acceleration change) of the vehicle.
A lower value leads to smoother motions but limits agility.

Setting this to the maximum value essentially disables the limit.

Only used with MPC_POS_MODE Acceleration based.

params.name: MPC_LAND_ALT1
params.short: Altitude for 1. step of slow landing (descend)
params.long:
Below this altitude descending velocity gets limited to a value
between "MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN" (or "MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN") and "MPC_LAND_SPEED"
Value needs to be higher than "MPC_LAND_ALT2"

params.name: MPC_LAND_ALT2
params.short: Altitude for 2. step of slow landing (landing)
params.long:
Below this altitude descending velocity gets
limited to "MPC_LAND_SPEED"
Value needs to be lower than "MPC_LAND_ALT1"

params.name: MPC_LAND_ALT3
params.short: Altitude for 3. step of slow landing
params.long:
If a valid distance sensor measurement to the ground is available,
limit descending velocity to "MPC_LAND_CRWL" below this altitude.

params.name: MPC_LAND_CRWL
params.long: Used below MPC_LAND_ALT3 if distance sensor data is availabe.

params.name: MPC_LAND_RADIUS
params.long:
When nudging is enabled (see MPC_LAND_RC_HELP), this controls
the maximum allowed horizontal displacement from the original landing point.

params.name: MPC_LAND_RC_HELP
params.short: Enable nudging based on user input during autonomous land routine
params.long:
Using stick input the vehicle can be moved horizontally and yawed.
The descend speed is amended:
stick full up - 0
stick centered - MPC_LAND_SPEED
stick full down - 2 * MPC_LAND_SPEED

Manual override during auto modes has to be disabled to use this feature (see COM_RC_OVERRIDE).

params.name: MPC_MANTHR_MIN
params.short: Minimum collective thrust in Stabilized mode
params.long:
The value is mapped to the lowest throttle stick position in Stabilized mode.

Too low collective thrust leads to loss of roll/pitch/yaw torque control authority.
Airmode is used to keep torque authority with zero thrust (see MC_AIRMODE).

params.name: MPC_MAN_TILT_MAX
params.short: Maximal tilt angle in Stabilized, Altitude and Altitude Cruise mode

params.name: MPC_MAN_Y_MAX
params.short: Max manual yaw rate for Stabilized, Altitude, Position mode

params.name: MPC_MAN_Y_TAU
params.short: Manual yaw rate input filter time constant
params.long:
Not used in Stabilized mode
Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter

params.name: MPC_POS_MODE
params.long:
The supported sub-modes are:
Direct velocity:
Sticks directly map to velocity setpoints without smoothing.
Also applies to vertical direction and Altitude mode.
Useful for velocity control tuning.
Acceleration based:
Sticks map to acceleration and there's a virtual brake drag

params.name: MPC_THR_CURVE
params.short: Thrust curve mapping in Stabilized Mode
params.long:
Defines how the throttle stick is mapped to collective thrust in Stabilized mode.

Rescale to hover thrust estimate:
Stick input is linearly rescaled, such that a centered throttle stick corresponds to the hover thrust estimator's output.

No rescale:
Directly map the stick 1:1 to the output.
Can be useful with very low hover thrust which leads to much distortion and the upper half getting sensitive.

Rescale to hover thrust parameter:
Similar to rescaling to the hover thrust estimate, but it uses the hover thrust parameter value (see MPC_THR_HOVER) instead of estimated value.
With MPC_THR_HOVER 0.5 it's equivalent to No rescale.

params.name: MPC_THR_HOVER
params.long:
Mapped to center throttle stick in Stabilized mode (see MPC_THR_CURVE).
Used for initialization of the hover thrust estimator (see MPC_USE_HTE).
The estimated hover thrust is used as base for zero vertical acceleration in altitude control.
The hover thrust is important for land detection to work correctly.

params.name: MPC_THR_MAX
params.short: Maximum collective thrust in climb rate controlled modes
params.long: Limit allowed thrust e.g. for indoor test of overpowered vehicle.

params.name: MPC_THR_MIN
params.short: Minimum collective thrust in climb rate controlled modes
params.long:
Too low thrust leads to loss of roll/pitch/yaw torque control authority.
With airmode enabled this parameters can be set to 0
while still keeping torque authority (see MC_AIRMODE).

params.name: MPC_THR_XY_MARG
params.long:
Margin that is kept for horizontal control when higher priority vertical thrust is saturated.
To avoid completely starving horizontal control with high vertical error.

params.name: MPC_TILTMAX_AIR
params.long:
Absolute maximum for all velocity or acceleration controlled modes.
Any higher value is truncated.

params.name: MPC_TILTMAX_LND
params.short: Maximum tilt during inital takeoff ramp
params.long: Tighter tilt limit during takeoff to avoid tip over.

params.name: MPC_TKO_RAMP_T
params.long:
Increasing this value will make climb rate controlled takeoff slower.
If it's too slow the drone might scratch the ground and tip over.
A time constant of 0 disables the ramp

params.name: MPC_USE_HTE
params.short: Use hover thrust estimate for altitude control
params.long:
Disable to use the fixed parameter MPC_THR_HOVER instead of the hover thrust estimate in the position controller.
This parameter does not influence Stabilized mode throttle curve (see MPC_THR_CURVE).

params.name: MPC_VELD_LP
params.short: Velocity derivative low pass cutoff frequency
params.long: A value of 0 disables the filter.

params.name: MPC_VEL_LP
params.long: A value of 0 disables the filter.

params.name: MPC_VEL_MANUAL
params.short: Maximum horizontal velocity setpoint in Position mode
params.long:
Must be smaller than MPC_XY_VEL_MAX.

The maximum sideways and backward speed can be set differently
using MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE and MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK, respectively.

params.name: MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK
params.short: Maximum backward velocity in Position mode
params.long:
If set to a negative value or larger than
MPC_VEL_MANUAL then MPC_VEL_MANUAL is used.

params.name: MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE
params.short: Maximum sideways velocity in Position mode
params.long:
If set to a negative value or larger than
MPC_VEL_MANUAL then MPC_VEL_MANUAL is used.

params.name: MPC_VEL_NF_BW
params.long: A value of 0 disables the filter.

params.name: MPC_VEL_NF_FRQ
params.long:
The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the velocity.
A value of 0 disables the filter.

params.name: MPC_XY_CRUISE
params.short: Default horizontal velocity in autonomous modes
params.long: e.g. in Missions, RTL, Goto if the waypoint does not specify differently

params.name: MPC_XY_ERR_MAX
params.short: Maximum horizontal error allowed by the trajectory generator
params.long:
The integration speed of the trajectory setpoint is linearly
reduced with the horizontal position tracking error. When the
error is above this parameter, the integration of the
trajectory is stopped to wait for the drone.

This value can be adjusted depending on the tracking
capabilities of the vehicle.

params.name: MPC_XY_P
params.short: Proportional gain for horizontal position error
params.long: Defined as corrective velocity in m/s per m position error

params.name: MPC_XY_TRAJ_P
params.short: Proportional gain for horizontal trajectory position error

params.name: MPC_XY_VEL_ALL
params.long:
If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
MPC_XY_VEL_MAX or MPC_VEL_MANUAL).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

params.name: MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC
params.short: Differential gain for horizontal velocity error
params.long: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative

params.name: MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC
params.short: Integral gain for horizontal velocity error
params.long:
Defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral
Allows to eliminate steady state errors in disturbances like wind.

params.name: MPC_XY_VEL_MAX
params.long:
Absolute maximum for all velocity controlled modes.
Any higher value is truncated.

params.name: MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC
params.short: Proportional gain for horizontal velocity error
params.long: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error

params.name: MPC_YAWRAUTO_ACC
params.short: Maximum yaw acceleration in autonomous modes
params.long:
Limits the acceleration of the yaw setpoint to avoid large
control output and mixer saturation.

params.name: MPC_YAWRAUTO_MAX
params.short: Maximum yaw rate in autonomous modes
params.long:
Limits the rate of change of the yaw setpoint to avoid large
control output and mixer saturation.

params.name: MPC_Z_P
params.short: Proportional gain for vertical position error
params.long: Defined as corrective velocity in m/s per m position error

params.name: MPC_Z_VEL_ALL
params.long:
If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP or MPC_LAND_SPEED).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

params.name: MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC
params.short: Differential gain for vertical velocity error
params.long: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative

params.name: MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC
params.short: Integral gain for vertical velocity error
params.long: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral

params.name: MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN
params.long:
Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes.
In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity.

For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

params.name: MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP
params.long:
Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes.
In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity.

For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

params.name: MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC
params.short: Proportional gain for vertical velocity error
params.long: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error

params.name: MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN
params.long: For manual modes and offboard, see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN

params.name: MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP
params.long: For manually controlled modes and offboard see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP

params.name: NAV_DLL_ACT
params.short: Set GCS connection loss failsafe mode
params.long:
The GCS connection loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_DL_LOSS_T in seconds. Once the timeout occurs the selected
action will be executed.

params.name: NAV_RCL_ACT
params.short: Set manual control loss failsafe mode
params.long:
The manual control loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_RC_LOSS_T in seconds.

params.name: SENS_BARO_RATE
params.long:
Barometric air data maximum publication rate. This is an upper bound,
actual barometric data rate is still dependent on the sensor.

params.name: SENS_BAR_AUTOCAL
params.long: Automatically calibrate barometer based on the GNSS height

params.name: SENS_BOARD_ROT
params.long: This parameter defines the rotation of the FMU board relative to the platform.

params.name: SENS_BOARD_X_OFF
params.long:
Rotation from flight controller board to vehicle body frame.
This parameter gets set during the "level horizon" calibration or can be
set manually.

params.name: SENS_BOARD_Y_OFF
params.long:
Rotation from flight controller board to vehicle body frame.
This parameter gets set during the "level horizon" calibration or can be
set manually.

params.name: SENS_BOARD_Z_OFF
params.long:
Rotation from flight controller board to vehicle body frame.
Has to be set manually (not set by any calibration).

params.name: SENS_DPRES_ANSC
params.long:
Pick the appropriate scaling from the datasheet.
this number defines the (linear) conversion from voltage
to Pascal (pa). For the MPXV7002DP this is 1000.

NOTE: If the sensor always registers zero, try switching
the static and dynamic tubes.

params.name: SENS_DPRES_OFF
params.long: The offset (zero-reading) in Pascal

params.name: SENS_DPRES_REV
params.long:
Reverse the raw measurements of all differential pressure sensors.
This can be enabled if the sensors have static and dynamic ports swapped.

params.name: SENS_EXT_I2C_PRB
params.long: Probe for optional external I2C devices.

params.name: SENS_FLOW_MAXHGT
params.short: Maximum height above ground when reliant on optical flow.
params.long:
This parameter defines the maximum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably.
The height setpoint will be limited to be no greater than this value when the navigation system
is completely reliant on optical flow data and the height above ground estimate is valid.
The sensor may be usable above this height, but accuracy will progressively degrade.

params.name: SENS_FLOW_MAXR
params.short: Magnitude of maximum angular flow rate reliably measurable by the optical flow sensor.
params.long:
Optical flow data will not fused by the estimators if the magnitude of the flow rate exceeds this value and
control loops will be instructed to limit ground speed such that the flow rate produced by movement over ground
is less than 50% of this value.

params.name: SENS_FLOW_MINHGT
params.short: Minimum height above ground when reliant on optical flow.
params.long:
This parameter defines the minimum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably.
The sensor may be usable below this height, but accuracy will progressively reduce to loss of focus.

params.name: SENS_FLOW_RATE
params.long:
Optical flow data maximum publication rate. This is an upper bound,
actual optical flow data rate is still dependent on the sensor.

params.name: SENS_FLOW_ROT
params.long:
This parameter defines the yaw rotation of the optical flow relative to the vehicle body frame.
Zero rotation is defined as X on flow board pointing towards front of vehicle.

params.name: SENS_GPS_MASK
params.long:
Set bits in the following positions to set which GPS accuracy metrics will be used to calculate the blending weight. Set to zero to disable and always used first GPS instance.
0 : Set to true to use speed accuracy
1 : Set to true to use horizontal position accuracy
2 : Set to true to use vertical position accuracy

params.name: SENS_GPS_PRIME
params.long:
When no blending is active, this defines the preferred GPS receiver instance.
The GPS selection logic waits until the primary receiver is available to
send data to the EKF even if a secondary instance is already available.
The secondary instance is then only used if the primary one times out.

To have an equal priority of all the instances, set this parameter to -1 and
the best receiver will be used.

This parameter has no effect if blending is active.

params.name: SENS_GPS_TAU
params.long: Sets the longest time constant that will be applied to the calculation of GPS position and height offsets used to correct data from multiple GPS data for steady state position differences.

params.name: SENS_IMU_AUTOCAL
params.long: Automatically initialize IMU (accel/gyro) calibration from bias estimates if available.

params.name: SENS_IMU_CLPNOTI
params.long: Notify the user if the IMU is clipping

params.name: SENS_INT_BARO_EN
params.long: For systems with an external barometer, this should be set to false to make sure that the external is used.

params.name: SENS_MAG_AUTOCAL
params.long: Automatically initialize magnetometer calibration from bias estimate if available.

params.name: SENS_MAG_AUTOROT
params.long: During calibration attempt to automatically determine the rotation of external magnetometers.

params.name: SENS_MAG_RATE
params.long:
Magnetometer data maximum publication rate. This is an upper bound,
actual magnetometer data rate is still dependent on the sensor.

params.name: SENS_MAG_SIDES
params.short: Bitfield selecting mag sides for calibration
params.long:
If set to two side calibration, only the offsets are estimated, the scale
calibration is left unchanged. Thus an initial six side calibration is
recommended.

Bits:
ORIENTATION_TAIL_DOWN = 1
ORIENTATION_NOSE_DOWN = 2
ORIENTATION_LEFT = 4
ORIENTATION_RIGHT = 8
ORIENTATION_UPSIDE_DOWN = 16
ORIENTATION_RIGHTSIDE_UP = 32

params.name: SYS_HITL
params.short: Enable HITL/SIH mode on next boot

params.name: SYS_VEHICLE_RESP
params.long:
Changes the overall responsiveness of the vehicle.
The higher the value, the faster the vehicle will react.

If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
the acceleration or jerk limits).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

params.name: THR_MDL_FAC
params.short: Thrust to motor control signal model parameter
params.long:
Parameter used to model the nonlinear relationship between
motor control signal (e.g. PWM) and static thrust.

The model is: rel_thrust = factor * rel_signal^2 + (1-factor) * rel_signal,
where rel_thrust is the normalized thrust between 0 and 1, and
rel_signal is the relative motor control signal between 0 and 1.
